answer: Because the timing is recorded against the prism challenge, the lagoon audit can replay the walnut history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 281 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 4255 identities would post 1632 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
